title: Figure 17: A MEMS biopotential electrode system (micrograph)
description: Grayscale micrograph of a tapered silicon electrode shank with thin conductor traces leading to several square exposed platinum pads near its pointed tip. The caption reads "Figure 17. A MEMS Biopotential Electrode System. It is approximately 100 microns in width. Each square pad is an electrically sensitive region. (Wikipedia)." It appears under the heading "Neuroengineering by BioMEMS."
